name: MorphingCommandPalette
description: Animated developer command palette with layout-aware selection pill, staggered search results, Up/Down/Enter/Escape keyboard handling, and focus management.
a11yNotes: Implements combobox/listbox keyboard navigation (ArrowUp, ArrowDown, Enter, Escape), automatic input focus on open, and reduced-motion transition fallback.

propsApi.name: staggerResults
propsApi.description: Delay in seconds between staggered result rows.
